class.name: LocalLRTVolume3D
class.brief_description: Configures a local LRT diffuse global illumination volume.
class.description: Defines a regular probe grid in local space. Translation, rotation and positive uniform scale are supported. The volume is centered on the node origin and edited through [member size], like [VoxelGI]. Drag the six face handles to resize a face, or hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] to resize symmetrically about the center. Grid snapping, cancel and undo use the standard 3D editor behavior. Probe positions start at -size / 2 and advance by [member probe_spacing]; the final probe on each axis may lie just beyond the bounds to cover a partial cell. [b]Development status:[/b] Geometry baking and rendering are not implemented yet. This node stores configuration and provides an editable volume gizmo; it does not change scene lighting.

method.name: get_bounds
method.description: Returns the local-space coverage AABB, centered on the node origin with dimensions [member size].

method.name: get_grid_size
method.description: Returns ceil(size / probe_spacing) + 1 on each axis, including the boundary probes.

members.member: Static geometry cache for this volume. Changes to size, spacing, static geometry or materials require rebaking.
Width of the final display blend at the volume boundary, measured in probe cells.
Whether this volume participates in LRT. The global rendering/lrt/enabled setting defaults to disabled.
Nonnegative display intensity, applied before volume blending, not to propagated boundary light.
Lower-priority volumes supply boundary lighting to higher-priority volumes. Higher priority also takes precedence in final blending.
Positive probe spacing in local meters. A carriage typically uses 0.25 meters.
Local-space volume dimensions in meters, centered on the node origin. All dimensions must be positive. Use the node transform to position and rotate the volume.
